'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Come in, have a seat. Want some tea? Well, suit yourself. Listen, I've got a bit of a situation. I'll be having guests before long, and I can't exactly take them hunting with worn-out old rifles, can I? I've got a couple of fine foreign bolt-action rifles, but they still need to be sighted in. Then it occurred to me... why not kill two birds with one stone? Break in the rifles and thin out the ranks of those gang leaders at the same time. Don't worry kid, I'll make it worth your while.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and neutralize any 20 [[Bosses]] with a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Bolt-action Rifles|Bolt-action Rifles skill]] levels
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks purchase of [[Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle]] at [[Jaeger]] LL4
{{quote|Those rifles turned out real fine! Maybe I'll take up gunsmithing myself one day. I like this kind of work. Here's your reward, just as I promised.}}
